purpose: Final conservative candidate: game-only arena cap, retaining baseline JVM arguments. Fresh full qualification follows two retained unsuccessful combinations.
cover_policy: No added GC, native trim timer, reclaim or freezing; ordinary covered pause only.

selection.arena_cap: Both isolated pairs saved 182-185 MiB settled and 248-295 MiB post-flight, with zero standing/flight frames over17ms. It is the dominant consistent isolated native-memory saving.
selection.native_interval: Omitted after the trim+arena combination added a 34.916ms flight frame versus its paired current control11.565ms. The cause is unknown; omission does not prove the timer caused it. The interval and arena gains overlap, so retain the simpler choice and measure it directly.
selection.headers: Initial header+native combination failed creation standing/flight comparison; retained under candidates/compact-headers-native.
selection.non_additive: No sum of isolated savings is asserted. Final arena-only creation, flatx3, Nether, long20 and NMT-off measurements must justify any shipping recommendation.
selection.excluded: No string dedup, LWJGL system allocation, worker limits or FerriteCore; forced covered GC exceeded50ms, and both frozen returns failed.

qualification.recommendation: Retain current product settings; arena cap is a measured follow-up candidate, not a fully qualified shipping set.
qualification.reason: One 19.948 ms flight frame in winner-flat-1 versus adjacent control 15.1 ms and zero frames over 17 ms; all three current flat controls have zero active frames over 17 ms. First-creation startup tail counts and individual wakes also differ. No later clean trial cancels these observations.
